title: dianthus sylvestris subsp. longicaulis
intro: Dianthus sylvestris subsp. longicaulis, commonly known as Fringed Pink or Long-petaled Wild Pink, is a flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus sylvestris subsp. longicaulis include its ability to act as an astringent, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
